# Kairos
**Player:** Quentin  **Campaign:** strixhaven-kairos  **Last Updated:** 2026-09-26

## Identity
- **Race:** Kenku (Multiverse; Kairos CAN speak) | **Class:** Wizard 1 (Chronurgy at 2) | **Level:** 1 | **Background:** Sage (reflavoured: Biblioplex Ward) → **Quandrix Student at 2.1** (`BACKGROUND-QUANDRIX.md`)
- **Alignment:** Neutral Good (leaning) | **XP:** 0 (milestone levelling; see world.md)

## Character Pillar
- **Player's sentence:** *"Even when the gods roll with dice, I make my own chance."*
- **Derived pillar:** Flaw: he sees every branch and hesitates to act (sees too much, acts too little)
- **Active hooks:** the thirteenth bell; Hesper's fear; "Kairos the Fortunate"

## Three Pillars

**Gimmick:** Improbably lucky, visibly untouchable. Rolls bend his way often enough that the nickname "Kairos the Fortunate" sticks.

**Conflict:** Hesper, who took him in, flinches around him and will not say why. He keeps winning by margins he cannot account for, and the thirteenth bell keeps ringing for him.

**Want:** Understand chance well enough to make his own, so no god's dice decide for him.

*Visual motif: a thirteenth bell stroke, one beat after the room stops listening.*

## Features & Traits

### Wizard
- **Arcane Recovery** (1/day, short rest: recover slots totalling up to half wizard level, rounded up).
- **Level 2, Chronurgy Magic:** Chronal Shift (reaction, 2/long rest: force a creature within 30 ft to reroll an attack, check or save you saw it make). Temporal Awareness (add INT mod to initiative).
- **Level plan:** Wizard 1-5 (levels 1-5), Fighter/Echo Knight 1-3 (levels 6-8, trained at Strixhaven; the first Fighter level is mandatory, taken at level 6), Wizard 6-7 (levels 9-10). Ends Wizard 7 / Fighter 3, ready to become Fighter 3 / Wizard 10 in Avernus.
- **Feat log:** Observant at Wizard 4 (level 4, INT 19 to 20). Strixhaven Initiate (Quandrix) is a story grant at the start of Year Two (Guidance, Mage Hand, Shield once per long rest without a slot, INT casting, plus the Quandrix spell list). War Caster at Wizard 8, in the Descent into Avernus campaign. No other feats. The Windfall (Chapter 1.2) is a boon, not a feat, and uses no ASI; the final feats are unchanged.

### Kenku Racial (Multiverse)
- **Expert Duplication:** advantage when copying writing or craftwork.
- **Kenku Recall (house rule, 2026-09-29):** advantage on **one ability check using any skill in which Kairos is proficient**. Uses = proficiency bonus = **2 per long rest**. This is the explicit reading of the sheet's own wording ("advantage on a check with a proficient skill") and is broader than Volo's two-kenku-skills rule. Proficient skills: Acrobatics, Arcana, History, Investigation, Perception, Stealth. **Nature is not proficient (+4) and cannot use Recall.**
- **⚠️ Religion is deliberately NOT proficient** (ruled by the Arbiter, 2026-09-30). The sheet previously credited it to *Kenku Recall*, but Recall is a house-rule **ability** that requires an already-proficient skill, it cannot be the source, and **2014 Kenku grants Stealth alone.** No other source is free: the background is locked to Acrobatics + Perception for the 0B gauntlet, Wizard's 2-of-4 is already History + Investigation, and there is no spare ASI. **Nothing is lost by this**, the 3.3 summoning reads *"Religion **or** Arcana DC 15"* and Arcana is proficient at +6 with Mabli's advantage, and the Student-Mages of Faith club grants a d4, not proficiency. Do not re-grant it without finding a real source.
- **Mimicry:** reproduce any sound or voice heard; Insight DC 8 + PB + CHA (DC 9) to detect.
- **Speech:** Kairos talks normally. He prefers precision and silence to small talk.

### Background, PROVISIONAL: Sage (reflavoured "Biblioplex Ward") until 2.1
- **Skills:** Acrobatics, Perception. **Feature: Researcher** (when he does not know a piece of lore, he usually knows where to look and whom to ask). Equipment: a bottle of black ink, a quill, a small knife, a letter (Hesper's first Found Day note), the grey first-year uniform (no college pin), and a battered mundane textbook, a borrowed Quandrix problem book, not the magic Annotated Primer of 2.1.
- **Language proficiencies:** Common, Draconic.
- **Tool proficiency:** Forgery Kit, archive restoration, copying damaged pages exactly; pairs with Expert Duplication. *(DM-granted today; at the swap it is **re-sourced onto the background line, not granted twice**, a GM must not invoke the duplicate-proficiency rule to displace it, or the 2.4 framing arc loses its basis.)*
- **⚠️ This placeholder is MIS-SOURCED and swapped at 2.1.** Verified at D&D Beyond, 2014 Sage: it grants a **fixed pair of Arcana and History**, *not* "two skills of your choice", plus two languages and the Researcher feature, and **no tool proficiency at all.** It therefore **never granted Acrobatics or Perception**, which is what this file and `state.md` both claimed for years. The only legal basis for those two skills was the homebrew reflavour above. Full audit: `BACKGROUND-QUANDRIX.md` §2.
- **The swap:** replaced by **Quandrix Student** (homebrew, *not* the book's, whose feature *is* Strixhaven Initiate). Lands at **2.1** in the same scene as the Initiate grant; **never conflate the two.** Carries Acrobatics, Perception and **Researcher** over unchanged, re-sources the Forgery Kit, and adds **Stacks Sense** (advantage once per long rest when searching for a handled object or reading the mood of a library; never in combat, never vs hidden or warded objects, never to move a DC). Design and reasoning: **`BACKGROUND-QUANDRIX.md`**.
- **Why these two skills are fixed for Kairos:** **Perception is the hard gate**, it carries **Station 2 (The Note He Kept)** in the Scene 0B gauntlet (DC 15, +2) and the **DC 10 tell-read** on Hesper's hesitation, the only telegraph in the garden. **Acrobatics is a courtesy, not a gate**, no trial in Scene 0B, but it carries the 1.4 rooftop chase, the 1.5 roof glass (DC 13), the 4.5 retrieval (DC 16) and the tournament. The background reads "choose two" so it stays a normal 5e choice for anyone else, but **for Kairos they are fixed and a GM must not re-pick them.** If Perception is ever re-picked, Station 2 must be re-specced in the same edit.

### The Windfall (boon, gained in Chapter 1.2)
Not a feat: it uses no ability score improvement and no feat slot.
- **Pool:** points equal to your proficiency bonus (2 at levels 1 to 4, 3 at levels 5 to 8, 4 at levels 9 and 10).
- **Refresh:** all points return on a long rest. If at your last decision point you stalled after the DM's second "you could still..." pause, only half return, rounded down.
- **Spend:** when you make an attack roll, ability check or saving throw of your own, spend 1 point to roll an extra d20 and use either die.
- **You must act:** you can spend only on a roll for an action you take yourself. Not on Dodge, Help, Ready, or a roll you make while stalling.
- **Never on:** death saves, proctored exams, or a roll already changed by Chronal Shift.

### Feats
- **Observant (from level 4):** +1 INT (19 to 20, the cap); +5 to passive Perception and passive Investigation; reads lips.
- **Strixhaven Initiate (Quandrix):** not owned at level 1. It is granted at the start of Year Two (see Feat log).

## Equipment & Inventory
**Arcane focus:** the **grey feather pen**, worn down to the shaft, Hesper's Found Day gift (0), the one she preened from her own moult and trimmed for him at six. **Not improvised:** a PHB improvised focus must resemble a wand or staff and a pen does not, so this is a focus she *made*, carrying the focus stat. **Seven of his nine known spells carry somatic components and cannot be cast without it**, only Feather Fall (V, M) and the material components escape it. It is why Mage Armor is up: he casts it as the scene opens.
**Not yet in his possession:** the **silver quill** is given in **1.1 Node C** and becomes his focus thereafter. **This is NOT the fledging feather**, that is a separate object, permanently withheld (see 4.5), and never reaches him at any point in this campaign. A three-beat prop arc: *given (0) → cast with, worn to the shaft (0B) → replaced (1.1)*. The replacement lands on the same night she withholds the fledging feather, so the two gestures rhyme.

## Backstory & Notes
Kairos remembers one word and darkness. Magister Hesper Vael, an Owlin Lorehold archaeomancer, raised him in the Biblioplex stacks and says she found him lost in Faerûn. She is proud of him and afraid of him. He leans Quandrix over Lorehold because he wants to know *why* things happen, not only *what* happened. He believes luck is probability you don't understand yet.

**Relationships (start):** Hesper +2 (guardian), Professor Orrin -1 (dislikes him on sight). Everyone else 0.
